_comment: Input to L1-design-lld, BOM Phase 4, DELTA MODE. Per the BOM row: the HLD deltas from design-hld, openapi.yaml from design-api-spec, and the current lld.md per affected component. As with the HLD, Cycle 1 is the first cycle for every component, so every current lld.md is absent and each delta is a creating one.

deltas.data_flow: Registration submitted -> RegistrationService validates format and attestation server-side -> Producer and FoodSafetyRegistration written with status pending-verification -> FboRegisterClient queries the competent-authority register asynchronously -> outcome written, identity.registration.verified emitted.
deltas.nfr_allocation: Availability 99.9%; getRegistrationStatus p95 <= 250 ms; FoodSafetyRegistration append-only, 6-year retention, approved PII region.
deltas.eligibility_boundary: identity-service owns the eligibility DECISION and exposes it through identity.registration-status@v1. Enforcement at publication is catalogue-service's, not built this cycle.

deltas.client_validation_posture: Client-side FBO format checking and the attestation guard are affordances, not controls. The server refuses independently.

deltas.consumer_obligations: Deduplication key from the business act (producer, registration number, verified-on date), not the message id. Idempotent. Bounded retry with backoff. Dead-letter path with a named owner. Replay policy: none — source event is Evidence kind.
deltas.content_boundary: No FBO number, no business identifier, no personal data beyond the addressee. Rejection reason passed through verbatim.

findings.summary: producer-portal's RegistrationStatusView is in the HLD and has no Work Unit.
The outbound FBO register call is a new egress path with no PLT-6 capability behind it.

content.execution_summary: • 3 creating HLD deltas, all additive, none structural.

constraints.rule: Identity is the sole writer of Producer, Buyer, Session and FoodSafetyRegistration

FoodSafetyRegistration is Regulated Evidence, append-only, 6-year retention, approved PII region. A lapsed registration is superseded, never overwritten, because a dispute asks what was true on the day of sale

data_architecture_constraints.note: The LLD may name classes and error handling. It may not change entity ownership, classification or retention — those are the data viewpoint's, and a change there is a data-architecture delta, not an LLD one.
